transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm just here because my sleep has gotten pretty messed up lately. I just... I'll either stay up half the night with my mind kind of running, or... I wake up way too early and feel like I never even rested. So, yeah. That's what brings me in.
Do you have trouble falling asleep when you first go to bed?
Yeah... like I was saying, I just end up staying awake for half the night. My brain just keeps running when I lie down. So... yeah, falling asleep is hard.
Do you often wake up earlier than you'd like and have trouble going back to sleep?
Yeah... um, like I said before, I do wake up way too early. And... I don't know, I just can't get back to sleep. I just end up feeling like I never even rested.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Lately, I just... I wake up with this really heavy feeling. It's kind of empty. Even just sitting in my condo... I worked really hard to get it, but now being there just makes me want to cry sometimes. So, yeah. I guess I have been feeling down.
Do these feelings of sadness or emptiness happen most days, and do they last throughout much of the day?
Um... yeah. Like I was just saying... it's pretty much every day. That heavy feeling is just... always there. I wake up with it, and it just kind of stays.
Would you say that your depressed mood is present for most of the day, nearly every day?
Um... yeah. Like I just said... it's there most of the time. I don't really know what else to tell you.
Have you noticed that you take less pleasure in things you used to enjoy, or find it hard to get interested in activities?

Yeah, I guess. I... I don't know. I used to go to this salsa class, but I just stopped. And... my paints are still sitting out on the table at home. I just look at them and... I don't feel anything. It's just like they belong to somebody else now. So, yeah. I guess I don't really care about that stuff anymore.
Would you say that your lack of interest or pleasure in activities is also accompanied by a feeling of being slowed down or restless most days?

I suppose so. Um... at work, sometimes I just... I catch myself moving really slow. Like, I'll just stare at the calculator for a bit before I even try to press any of the buttons. And then... I don't know. Other times I just can't sit still and I end up just fidgeting with the receipts on my desk. So... yeah. Both, I guess.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Um... I guess so. My appetite's just been... off. Like, I'll just skip dinner a lot. Or I just eat some crackers while I'm looking over my budget notebook. And... I don't know, my work pants feel a little looser than they did a few weeks ago. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or like you don’t have any energy lately?

Um... yeah. I guess. Even if I spend the whole night in bed... just walking from the parking lot into the office feels like I'm... I don't know, dragging sandbags or something. And... by lunchtime, my brain just feels completely worn out. So... yeah. I'm pretty tired.
Have you been feeling like you're not worth much, or blaming yourself for things more than usual lately?

Um... I guess I've been pretty hard on myself. I just... I keep thinking about the house. Like, I tell myself it was stupid to take on the mortgage in the first place. And... I don't know, I just feel like I've let everyone down. Even though I haven't actually missed a payment or anything yet. I just... yeah. I feel pretty useless.
How long have you been feeling this way — with the sadness, trouble sleeping, and loss of interest in things?

Um... I don't know exactly. It's been a while. I guess... maybe around five months? It just feels like this... fog I can't shake. It definitely got a lot worse after I bought the condo, but... yeah. It's been a few months.
Have you had episodes of depression like this before, or is this the first time you've felt this way?
Um... I don't think so. I mean... I've had bad days before, like anyone, but... not like this. So... yeah, I guess this is the first time it's been this bad.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or that life isn't worth living?
Um... no. I haven't... I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I wouldn't do that.

The severity could still be mild (F32.1), moderate (F32.2), or severe (F32.3) based on the extent of symptoms and functional impairment described.
